name: Skullcrusher cannon
description: A turret of glowing plasma lobbed in slow, heavy balls. Orc gunners say it sounds like a door being kicked in.

name: Skullcrusher mega-cannon
description: The big brother of the Skullcrusher, bolted to the dorsal ridges of khanate flagships. One hit shakes the whole target.

name: Chatterfang battery
description: Quad pulse mounts that fire in short, ugly bursts. Cheap on power and loud enough to hear through the hull.

name: Boulder-hurler
description: A mass driver the length of a small freighter, loaded with slugs of slag. Crude, but it reaches a long way.

name: Rattler flak battery
description: Throws clouds of shrapnel that burst near anything small and fast. Raiders fit it to keep fighters off the flanks.

name: Gutripper torpedo rack
description: A slow, huge homing torpedo with a warhead sized to open a cruiser. Khanate crews paint a tally on each tube.

name: Popper missile rack
description: A small rack of homing missiles for fighters. Short on guidance and long on bang.

name: Popper missile pod
description: A pod of heavier homing missiles. Raiders fire the whole lot at the first thing that turns its back.
